content.value: Every element renders as a box with content, padding, border, and margin. A common beginner mistake is mixing width calculations. Use consistent spacing rules and inspect each box layer in devtools when layouts shift unexpectedly.

concepts.name: Content box
concepts.description: The innermost area of an element box where content is displayed.

concepts.name: Padding
concepts.description: Space between an element’s content and its border.

concepts.name: Border
concepts.description: The line or edge surrounding an element’s padding and content.

concepts.name: Margin
concepts.description: Space outside an element’s border separating it from neighboring elements.

concepts.name: box-sizing
concepts.description: A CSS property controlling whether width and height include content only or also padding and border.

concepts.name: Spacing scale
concepts.description: A consistent set of spacing values used to create rhythm and alignment in a design.
